purpose: Flat source samples for Blender hand atlas albedo; geometry and normal maps remain authored in Blender.

sources.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless game material base-color texture source, square 1024 by 1024. Create a strictly top-down, flat, uniformly illuminated sample of adult hand skin pigmentation, medium-light warm neutral/olive tan. This is only the surface material, filling the whole image edge to edge; no hand outline, fingers, nails, objects, text, border, labels or watermark. Include restrained irregular warm/cool mottling, very fine pores, faint natural creases and subtle freckle variation, believable living skin without exaggerated age, dirt, wounds or strong red patches. Preserve a nearly even average color across the tile. Diffuse albedo only: no directional illumination, cast shadows, specular shine, vignette, ambient occlusion, or perspective. It will be projected onto a separately modeled hand with real baked normals; do not depict geometric folds with dark fake shading. Visually seamless repeat at every edge, fine natural scale, understated detail that survives downsampling.

sources.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless game material base-color texture source, square 1024 by 1024. Create a strictly top-down, flat, uniformly illuminated sample of worn soft tactical-glove leather, very dark charcoal with a restrained muted olive undertone. Material fills the entire image edge to edge. Fine irregular natural leather grain, slightly softened worn high spots, subtle diffuse color variation and lightly rubbed areas; avoid glossy plastic, regular stippling or reptile scales. Base-color/albedo only: no directional light, cast shadows, highlights, ambient occlusion, vignette or perspective. No actual glove, fingers, seams, stitching, panel shapes, hardware, objects, words, logos, borders or watermark: these already exist in the Blender model. Seamless repeat at all edges. Keep the material dark but retain visible gentle grain and low-contrast wear; no bright scratches or decorative designs.
